name: La Coma i la Pedra (Spain)
description: Red field with a white cross patty throughout, charged with two yellow thistles of three flowers in the lower quarters.
history: Municipal flag of La Coma i la Pedra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: two thistles of three flowers in the lower hoist and lower fly quarters
